cards.card_text: She's wearing the attire of a harlot, and she's cunning of heart.
cards.verse_text: Then a woman came out to meet him, with the attire of a harlot and cunning of heart.
cards.snippet: …a woman came out to meet him, with the attire of a harlot and cunning of heart.

cards.card_text: Now Isaiah says, "See how the faithful city has become a harlot!"
cards.verse_text: See how the faithful city has become a harlot!
cards.snippet: See how the faithful city has become a harlot!

cards.card_text: At the end of those seventy years, Isaiah says it will happen to Tyre as in the song of the harlot.
cards.verse_text: But at the end of seventy years, it will happen to Tyre as in the song of the harlot: “Take up your harp, stroll through the city, O forgotten harlot.
cards.snippet: …years, it will happen to Tyre as in the song of the harlot: “Take up your harp, stroll through the city, O forgotten harlot.

cards.card_text: In the song, why does the forgotten harlot take up her harp and sing many a song?
cards.verse_text: “Take up your harp, stroll through the city, O forgotten harlot.
cards.snippet: “Take up your harp, stroll through the city, O forgotten harlot.

cards.card_text: Israel has played the harlot with many lovers.
cards.verse_text: But you have played the harlot with many lovers—and you would return to Me?” declares the LORD.
cards.snippet: But you have played the harlot with many lovers—and you would return to Me?” declares the LORD.

cards.card_text: She plays the harlot, and her beauty is there for anyone who passes by.
cards.verse_text: But because of your fame, you trusted in your beauty and played the harlot.
cards.snippet: …because of your fame, you trusted in your beauty and played the harlot.

cards.card_text: The reason given: their mother has played the harlot.
cards.verse_text: For their mother has played the harlot and has conceived them in disgrace.
cards.snippet: For their mother has played the harlot and has conceived them in disgrace.

cards.card_text: Then the LORD says, 'For a spirit of prostitution leads them astray and they have played the harlot against their God.'
cards.verse_text: For a spirit of prostitution leads them astray and they have played the harlot against their God.
cards.snippet: …a spirit of prostitution leads them astray and they have played the harlot against their God.

cards.card_text: The message calls it playing the harlot against God, making 'love for hire on every threshing floor.' Keep your eye on those threshing floors, friend, because this message isn't done with them.
cards.verse_text: Do not rejoice, O Israel, with exultation like the nations, for you have played the harlot against your God; you have made love for hire on every threshing floor.
cards.snippet: …O Israel, with exultation like the nations, for you have played the harlot against your God; you have made love for hire on every threshing…

cards.card_text: It's 'because of the many harlotries of the harlot, the seductive mistress of sorcery…'
cards.verse_text: because of the many harlotries of the harlot, the seductive mistress of sorcery, who betrays nations by her prostitution and clans by her witchcraft.
cards.snippet: because of the many harlotries of the harlot, the seductive mistress of sorcery, who betrays nations by her prostitution and…
